fields.name: Language
fields.description: The language for this lemma. This field cannot be changed after creation.
fields.guidance: Language is set when the lemma is first created and determines script rules, sorting behavior, and validation.

fields.name: Native Text
fields.description: The lemma in its native script (e.g., Devanagari for Marathi). This is the dictionary form—the base, uninflected word.
fields.guidance: Use the canonical form: verbs in infinitive (धावणे), nouns in singular form (मुलगा), adjectives in base form (लाल). Do not enter inflected or conjugated forms here—those belong to Surface Forms.

actions: Review and update Meanings if the lemma's definitions have changed
Update or add Usage Sentences that demonstrate correct usage
Add or update Pronunciations (audio) as needed
Manage Surface Forms for inflected variations (e.g., "धावली", "धावतो")

items.content: Use the status buttons above the form to promote the lemma through the workflow: DRAFT → REVIEW → PUBLISHED. Once published, changes should be carefully reviewed as they affect the public dictionary.
